f35253b17-5e7b-4563-bb79-b55a045f08e3.notes: Hand-painted wall sign of 'Samikaran Academic Coaching' (Dhaka), frontal and sharp. The business name and address are Bengali only; the only Latin text is the exam acronyms 'SSC, HSC' and the phone numbers, so it is labelled negative. Bengali digits in the year and house number (১৫৩), Western digits in the phone numbers. The row of dots after চলছে is five dots on the sign.
